repos_data.description: The Architecture Guardian for AI-assisted code. Generate strict .cursorrules and audit PRs.
Architectural drift prevention for the agentic AI SDLC.

repo_meta_data.description: Infers architecture rules from your TypeScript repo's real import graph, gates each on statistical evidence, and emits them into the tools you already use (ESLint, dependency-cruiser, ts-arch). Turns the boundaries your code already follows into enforcement, so architecture drift gets caught, not just documented.
